nom: SUNGBOON EDITOR Deep Collagen Power Boosting Cream In Serum

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin describe the serum as fast-absorbing and effective at relieving tightness and dryness, especially in winter or summer heat, without feeling greasy.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive or reactive skin report the product did not irritate or trigger breakouts, and one describes it as transformative after years of reactions to other products.
segments.combination: A reviewer with combination skin and one with oily/combo acne-prone skin both report the serum did not cause breakouts and left skin even and hydrated.
segments.mature: Reviewers over 40-50 report visible reduction in fine lines, wrinkles and smile lines, improved firmness, and being told they look younger.

concerns.aging: Multiple reviewers report visible reduction in fine lines, wrinkles, and smile/marionette lines within days to weeks, plus improved firmness and elasticity; one reviewer found it no better than a peptide serum from another brand and returned it.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe strong, fast hydration and a plumping, dewy effect that lasts through the day, useful in both winter dryness and summer heat.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with sensitive, reactive skin reports no irritation and a calmer, glassy look after use.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer credits the serum with healing their skin barrier alongside fading acne marks quickly.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports smudges/blemishes fading within one to two days of use.
concerns.blemishes: Reports are mixed: several reviewers with acne-prone or combination skin say it does not break them out and even helps clear blemishes, but three reviewers explicitly describe new breakouts after use, one of them stopping repurchase.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer with oily/combo skin reports it controls shine while keeping skin hydrated and glowing, without heaviness.

aspects.libelle: No visible results for some users

extraits.texte: I am a 54 year old with past sun damage. I also have VERY sensitive skin and every time I have tried something to help my skin, I would break out or have a skin reaction. I decided a few months ago that I needed to spend more time reading about K beauty products and this product continually popped up in different forums as highly effective. Since it wasn't expensive, I decided to try it. I honestly have no words for what this has done to my skin. I agree with a previous reviewer where she said that this is "magical." This is how I would describe it. I have not had skin like this in years. I have had a SIGNIFICANT reduction in fine lines and wrinkles, a daily healthy glow, and improvements in firmness. As an added bonus, it has been an incredible primer for my makeup. The amount of compliments I have received on my skin has blown me away. But most importantly, I feel so much better about how I look as I go through hormonal changes. In case anyone is wondering, I have not added any other new products to my regiment. I was only using Clinique Moisture Surge prior to this (again- my skin is so sensitive that this was about all I could handle). So the Collagen serum was the only addition so this is how I know how effective this product is! It also feels soooo good on the skin. It is important that you shake the bottle before you use the dripper so the ingredients can mix. At this price point and Ulta's excellent return policy, this should be a no brainer for you to try.
